content.title: EVALUATING MACHINE LEARNING DAILY SALES FORECASTING FOR SMALL LOCAL FARMS: A CASE STUDY OF ORANGE SALES AT ARNOTT FARMS
content.abstract: Of the many methods that can be used to stabilize a supply chain, obtaining an accurate demand forecast is described in the literature as being a key step. With advances in computing power, machine learning-based demand forecasting models have emerged as an alternative to traditional statistics-based methods. Arnott Farms is a small farm in Mentone, California that operates a small grocery store as a distribution channel.
